<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 183.0451, which corresponds to a [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.0378 Da. The isotopic pattern shows a strong M+2 peak (~32 % of the base peak), characteristic of a single chlorine atom. The formula that matches this exact mass and the chlorine isotopic signature is C₁₀H₁₁OCl.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H11OCl</final_answer>
